Track E3 group tool-clippy-vendored: build track-e3.md section E3-1 (Tests, tooling, protocol and docs) group tool-clippy-vendored. Gap code-3. One commit: "A script lints the vendored minecraftoss crates with clippy". Key points:
- New scripts/clippy-vendored.ps1, shaped like scripts/full-suite.ps1, with no comments.
- Arguments: +target=, +wait= and +exclusive are passed through to cargo-slot.ps1. Every other argument is a crate name, short (entities) or full (minecraftoss-entities); no name means all five. An unknown name prints the usage and exits 2.
- It lints in its own folder <target>\clippy-vendored, where <target> is the +target dir, else $env:CARGO_TARGET_DIR, else D:\iw4l-target. Every unit there is built through clippy-driver, so cargo's replay shows clippy's warnings and the track's own dir never gets clippy-built units: no touching, no replay on later plain checks.
- It saves $env:RUSTC_WRAPPER and $env:CARGO_TARGET_DIR, sets RUSTC_WRAPPER=clippy-driver (cargo-slot puts .cargo\bin on Path), runs `& $slot +target=<lint dir> check -p minecraftoss-<crate>... --locked --all-targets`, and restores both variables in finally. cargo-slot sets CARGO_TARGET_DIR in the caller's session (:85), so the restore matters.
